title: Hermes Memory Vault — close 7 gaps vs Simback's 2026-05-23 Hermes Memory Guidebook + 4 deeper Obsidian/Qdrant/Hermes synergies

units.title: Mnemosyne-style tiered consolidation — working/episodic/long-term memory promotion
units.description: Auto-promote memory entries through working→episodic→long-term tiers. Today feedback→reference→wiki is manual. Build a Stop-hook driver that scans recent feedback_*.md, increments a reference-count + age signal, and proposes promotion when threshold crossed. Pure-core lib + driver. Operator-gated promote, NEVER auto-mutates wiki.
units.exit_criteria: lib + tests (≥6 cases, 3 spanning tier transitions) + Stop driver + advisory output

units.title: Explainable retrieval — yantrikdb-style 'why retrieved' trace on every master-index hit
units.description: Extend master-index-precheck-inject.mjs output to include per-hit explanation: matched tokens, BM25 component scores, corpus name, embedding-distance breakdown. Operator can audit WHY each suggestion surfaced. Lower-effort high-leverage UX win.
units.exit_criteria: extended scoring lib + test cases asserting explanation structure
units.notes: PARTIAL (slot:zulu 2026-06-10): RECALL surface DONE -- memory-index-search-lib.mjs runMemoryIndexSearch now returns per-hit `explanation` {matchedTokens, corpus, denseArm (qdrant|scan|null), denseSim, bm25Score, rrf} on EVERY path (hybrid + sidecar + live), threaded through tryHybridFuse; memory-index-precheck-inject.mjs renders a compact [via <arm> <cosine> bm25:<n> matched:<toks>] tag when PRISM_MEMORY_INDEX_EXPLAIN=1 (default OFF -> byte-identical fleet-wide, no per-prompt token cost). matchedTokens() exported, 4 tests (73 lib total). LIVE: real hit -> 'arm=qdrant denseSim=0.70 bm25=14 matched=[obsidian,hermes,acceleration]'. NOTE (R7): the spec literally named master-index-precheck-inject (the system-graph BM25-only surface); built on the memory-VAULT recall surface instead -- it is the milestone-faithful (HERMES-MEMORY-VAULT) + higher-value target (the only surface with dense/BM25 fusion worth explaining). DONE 2026-06-10: master-index surface ALSO shipped (commit U-HMEMV02-MASTERINDEX) -- explainNodeMatch() + searchGraphHits per-hit `explanation` {matchedTokens, fields, corpus, score} + master-index-precheck-inject.mjs render tag (PRISM_MASTER_INDEX_EXPLAIN=1, default OFF), 60 master-index tests. BOTH surfaces (recall + master-index) complete; status -> completed.

units.title: Temporal-aware recall — 'what did I believe about X at time T?' point-in-time memory query
units.description: First-class point-in-time recall over the memory dir + wiki via git log. Today operators do `git show <ref>:<path>` manually. Build prism_memory:recall_at_time action that walks memory git log + reconstructs the state-of-belief at the requested timestamp. Matches Mnemosyne's standout feature per Simback.
units.exit_criteria: lib + dispatcher action + ≥3 spanning time-window tests

units.title: Background 'dream cycle' — overnight synthesis pass (GBrain pattern)
units.description: Scheduled task running off-peak that scans recent memories + wiki + tribal, surfaces contradictions, proposes consolidations + cross-references. Builds on close-out-audit but adds synthesis. Operator-gated promote. Bigger version of `audit-close-out-candidates.mjs`.
units.exit_criteria: scheduled task + lib + ≥3 dream-cycle reports under state/shared/dream-cycle/

units.title: Memory-router intercept — auto-inject relevant memory into ANY LLM dispatch (Mem0 pattern)
units.description: Extend aiSystemRouterEngine.route() with a preMemoryInject phase: every routed call automatically receives top-K relevant memory hits as system-context prefix. Today auto-injectors fire only on UserPromptSubmit; this extends to every internal LLM dispatch (octopus, prismCreativeReasoning, etc).
units.exit_criteria: router extension + tests + smoke through prism_ai dispatcher

units.title: Reflect-on-own-memory — Hindsight-style reasoning over memory store
units.description: prismCreativeReasoningEngine.reflect(memoryStore) periodically synthesizes patterns from accumulated memories. Closes the 'memory + reasoning' loop the article highlights as uniquely valuable when running multi-agent fleets on shared memory.
units.exit_criteria: engine extension + 1 batch reflection per slot per week

units.title: Predictive memory warmup — FlowState-QMD pattern (pre-load likely-next memory hits)
units.description: Based on session activity pattern, pre-load likely-next memory hits into the rag index cache. Rides on octopus-record-lib outcomes — frequently-followed prompt patterns inform warmup. Eliminates first-hit latency.
units.exit_criteria: warmup lib + integration with stale-ness check (U-HFR05); ≥3 prediction patterns tested

units.title: Obsidian Bases integration — frontmatter-pivoted views over wiki+memory
units.description: Obsidian Bases (2025+ feature) lets you build database-style views from frontmatter fields. PRISM's wiki+memory already use frontmatter (name/description/type/tags). Ship .base files that expose: (a) memory-by-type, (b) wiki-by-domain, (c) shipped-skills-by-slot. Operator gets instant pivot tables without leaving Obsidian.

units.title: Qdrant migration — tribal+wiki+memory vectors → Qdrant collection (filtered hybrid retrieval)
units.description: Migrate tribal-embed-index.json + wiki vector index to a local Qdrant instance. Unlocks: scale beyond 10K entries, filtered semantic search (per-leg/per-domain), sparse+dense hybrid, scalar/binary quantization (smaller mem), persistent+restartable. INTEL-OLLAMA-OBSIDIAN-MS0/P13 already added the Qdrant docker-compose; this unit wires the corpora.
units.exit_criteria: Qdrant collection seeded from existing indexes + reRankerEngine fallback path preserved
units.notes: PARTIAL 2-of-3 corpora (slot:zulu 2026-06-10/11): (1) MEMORY corpus DONE -- prism_memories seeded with 17,032 vault-memory vectors (producer populate-qdrant-memories.mjs a165f4166e) + LIVE recall consumer (memory-index-search-lib.mjs denseRankViaQdrant) sources dense from Qdrant ANN, linear int8 scan fail-soft (PRISM_MEMORY_QDRANT_DISABLE=1). units.title: Hermes-MemoryProvider compliance — expose PRISM PSN as a Hermes-compatible provider
units.description: Wrap PRISM's PSN-via-master-index as a Hermes MemoryProvider ABC-compatible interface (extends MemoryProvider). Externally exposes search/store/forget. Lets Hermes-native agents use PRISM as their L2 provider. Cross-agent PSN benefit without bridging.
units.exit_criteria: MemoryProvider stub + 4 ABC methods + integration test via Hermes harness if available; else contract-only

units.title: Dataview-runtime queries — operator-callable queries from inside Obsidian over PRISM state
units.description: Ship Dataview query snippets under knowledge/wiki/queries/*.md that operators can copy into their daily-notes / dashboards. Queries: (a) shipped this week by slot, (b) deferred close-outs, (c) memory by promotion-readiness, (d) wiki orphans. Each is a single-file md with frontmatter + dataview JS-LIKE syntax.

advisory: All 11 units are operator-reviewable + operator-gated promote; nothing in this milestone mutates live wiki/memory/CLAUDE.md without operator action.
notes: Derived from Simback's article (2026-05-23) comparing PRISM vs Hermes 3-layer architecture; PRISM exceeds on 7 axes (doctrine, wiki, system-viz, fleet, PSN, multi-vendor, closed-loop) but has 7 frontier gaps + 4 deeper synergies (Obsidian Bases/Dataview + Qdrant + Hermes-MemoryProvider compliance).
